reply_text:
I told Pree in a thread reply on her message in #central-team that the store is Pine Crossing.

Where it comes from: her own message in #central-team on June 9. She wrote that Pine Crossing's morning receiver saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen, after a driver arrived at 7:10. Hollis replied that he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem with the store login. I couldn't find a later message in that channel saying it was fixed, and I told her that too. I only read #central-team and public files, all of which she can see.

The knowledge brain (gbrain) refused the search and read nothing, because its connection isn't linked to any member yet. Someone on the brain host has to fix this by linking it to a member or setting who it may act for. For example: gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member '<MEMBER>'. I haven't run that, since it's an admin action on that host.
